description:
A lightweight, developer-focused database management tool. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite. Hackable with plugins. Built for speed, security, and aesthetics.


📖 Read the announcement blog post: https://tabularis.dev/blog/v0210-sql-folding-per-tab-page-size-postgres-mtls?utm_src=github-release
See the assets below to download this version and install.
What's Changed
- build(deps): bump tauri-apps/tauri-action from 0.6.1 to 1.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in #601
- Editors whose tab was not active on first render never landed in edit… by @GabrielMalava in #603
- Fix database UI query issues by @DhruvShah-Dev in #613
- Allow plugin installations to be cancelled by @debba in #665
- fix: unify safety confirmation guards by @debba in #667
- fix: run the SSL-mode migration from the --mcp server process (#639) by @aesslinger in #643
- Fix: Keep "Manage databases" and "Refresh" controls visible when a single database is selected by @gcapellib in #635
- fix(snap): ship a desktop entry so the app appears in the launcher by @janpetto in #670
- fix(postgres): support client certificate authentication (mTLS) by @adisusilayasa in #666
- fix(editor): handle qualified tables in grid editing by @debba in #660
- feat: per-tab page size selector in the results pagination bar by @debba in #675
- feat(editor): add SQL query folding previews by @debba in #674
- fix: show production banner only in editor by @debba in #677
- Fix multi-statement result export by @DhruvShah-Dev in #628
- Hide SQLite virtual table internals by @DhruvShah-Dev in #624
- Support manual TablePlus import path by @DhruvShah-Dev in #625
New Contributors
- @janpetto made their first contribution in #670
- @adisusilayasa made their first contribution in #666
